verdict.rationale: The only bulk-operation evidence is a one-time 'bulk upload tools' import feature used during spreadsheet migration (docs-17), not a general capability to perform bulk actions across many cap table items (e.g., mass edits, batch grants, bulk certificate issuance) in normal use. The MCP/AI assistant integration is explicitly read-only (docs-27), so it cannot perform bulk write operations either. Missing for 10: evidence of bulk edit/update/delete across grants, stakeholders, or certificates in regular workflows, and any AI-driven bulk action capability beyond read-only queries.
